model.name: R19.87: iOS — all file types must open preview drawer, not just vcard.
model.description: BUG (iOS-specific): on iPhone, only text/vcard files open the ContentPreviewer/detail drawer. Image, HTML, URL/webitem files do NOT open the drawer on iOS — they work on desktop. Root cause likely: iOS Safari touch event handling differs (click vs touchend delegation, passive listeners, or 300ms tap delay interfering with the file-item click handler). FIX: the file-click → drawer-open path must work on iOS Safari for ALL content types (image, html, url, vcard, etc.), not just vcard. Test on real iPhone Safari + PWA.
model.tronQuote: > TRON: "on desktop the url drawer works, but especially on iphone it does not — only for the vcard. all others dont open the drawer."
model.crossRefNote: R19.86 (URL drawer regression) may be the same root cause on desktop, now confirmed iOS-wider. R19.73 (in-room preview) is the feature. R19.87 isolates the iOS-specific failure: only vcard works, all others broken.
